_readme: [MidAutumn2024 2026-10-14] Lunar Voyage = the official 2024 Global Mid-Autumn entry (client msg 10459 FuiZhongqiu2024).
Top bar: Fgui button 10459 (client fguibtnconfig, img lua_2024qqzqj_btn32, label 'Lunar Voyage') while the festival below runs.
Click -> MainNpc2024_Interface -> window FuiZhongQiu2024Main (6 voyage areas, Moon Discovery, Bounty Park, Treasure Attic).
Official (client): the ids, texts, rules, area count (6), endings per area (1,1,1,2,2,2), the 3 currency items.
Derived (edit here): festival, minLevel, Moon Discovery destination (= the Chang'E herald teleport of MidAutumnVillage),
the maps the window may teleport from, and the ending reward items (the server data is not in the client: empty = no icon).
_currency: Heart Grass, Crescent Gem, Plenilune Gem (luaUiRes 10459 Rule 1 order)
_teleportFromMaps: Moon Discovery teleports only from these maps (cities + the Moon Palace itself), never from instances/arenas/jail.
_endingRewards: Per area, per ending: client item string 'itemtype 0 count' shown under 'Ending Reward Preview'. Unknown -> empty.
